title: fix(settings): the Appearance options are cut off at the largest text size
body:
At the largest system text size, the option labels in `components/AppearanceControl.tsx` ("Match phone", "Dark", "Light") are clipped, so it is not clear which one is which.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every Appearance option reads in full at the largest system text size, in both themes
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
source: synthetic; replaced 2026-10-24, since the main pin has no ThemeToggle (Appearance is a radio group in Settings)
why: No Size on the board or in the body: the skill estimates one, says so, and proceeds.
